name: Julie Smith
reason: Health rule: her own site (julie-smith.net, read 5 Nov 2026) sells her meditation teaching on conditions throughout: the home and About pages promise relief from burnout, stress, anxiety and poor sleep, the workshops include Beating Burnout and Overcoming Insomnia, the member-class, 15 Min Mornings and Spain retreat pages are framed on the same conditions, and there is a Peaceful Sleep System, so almost nothing passes. The site also looks stale (courses dated 2022, latest blog 2021). Note for the owner: she names B. Alan Wallace as her main teacher and publishes julie@julie-smith.net and a contact form, with London classes at Violet Hill Studios, if the owner wants to reconsider.
